metadata.title: Implementation 02 Plan
metadata.purpose: This file outlines an implementation plan.

implementation_intent.summary: Create Archive Manager as the place where evidence taxonomy, run phase summaries, closeout records, and citation-ready archive records become concrete.
implementation_intent.why_it_matters: Archive Manager turns run evidence, validation results, and closeout claims into durable citation-ready records instead of leaving future PM reports to reconstruct state from raw artifacts.

implementation_intent.summary: Define historical/current evidence taxonomy and per-file artifact classification.
implementation_intent.why_it_matters: Interactions with PM reinforcing state mechanics of implementations, close-out of current and open of next require delineation standard.

implementation_intent.summary: Draft closeout record shape to seed archive record as citation-ready evidence.
implementation_intent.why_it_matters: Once taxonomy is decided a standard shape for retention can be drafted.

implementation_intent.summary: Reduce PM agent prose only where equivalent behavior is now enforced by schema, validator, route config, or explicit state.
implementation_intent.why_it_matters: Operational aspects and governance characteristics get ontology, behavior gets prose.

implementation_intent.summary: Affected/non-affected surfaces and stop_conditions must be accounted for, but it should not force invented surfaces.
implementation_intent.why_it_matters: That prevents hallucination while still forcing coverage.

implementation_intent.summary: Add a disposition enum for PM report source coverage.
implementation_intent.why_it_matters: Increase coverage precision in PM report.

implementation_intent.summary: Keep Implementation 02 contracts provisional but valid: outputs should be concrete enough to validate and test, while remaining easy to revise as the harness ontology matures.
implementation_intent.why_it_matters: This is a greenfield system, so the slice should produce working inspectable surfaces without pretending the first version is permanent.

seams.title: Archive record schema
seams.description: Defines the citation-ready archive record shape for bounded implementation closeout and saved run evidence.
evidence_target: Archive record validates against schema and can cite source run artifacts.

seams.title: Artifact classification
seams.description: Classifies saved run files as task, context, provider, report, validation, ledger, or archive evidence.
evidence_target: Run artifacts receive stable artifact_type values, run evidence being the most important.

seams.title: PM coverage disposition
seams.description: Adds explicit source coverage disposition so PM reports distinguish used, insufficient, irrelevant, invalid, and missing sources.
evidence_target: ProjectManagerReport validation accepts all valid dispositions, rejects empty required coverage and consumed/disposition mismatches, and preserves the existing proof-frontier and constraint-conflict truth tables.
Focused validation passes 67 tests and full unittest discovery passes 167 tests.
The migrated Implementation 02 PM smoke report validates against both ProjectManagerReport.schema.json and the ProjectManagerReport Pydantic model.

seams.title: PM prose migration
seams.description: Removes PM prose that is now enforced by schema, validator, route config, or explicit state while preserving thesis-attractor and tension-surfacing judgment prose.
evidence_target: PM agent contract is shorter and still produces valid admissibility reports.

seams.title: AM creation
seams.description: Create the Archive manager agent.json and associated Pydantic model and schema.
evidence_target: AM agent json and Pydantic models.

non_goals: External tooling beyond the archive/report surfaces required for this slice.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Archive record schema exists and validates an example closeout record.
Artifact taxonomy classifies the saved run files needed for Implementation 01 closeout.
required_evidence: test or fixture using a prior run bundle

acceptance_criteria.criterion: PM source coverage supports explicit disposition instead of only consumed true/false.
PM agent prose is reduced only where enforcement now exists in code or state.
required_evidence: valid PM smoke-test report after pruning

non_affected_surfaces: Provider specific payload model, call runner and raw response model.
completion_rules: Scaffolds and templates are not admissible.

approval_gates.requires: An admissible AM report that allows a future PM report can cite the archive record instead of reconstructing the whole saga from raw run artifacts.
